senses.gloss: (or מָר) m. (מוּר) exchange; במֹר ד־ instead of; as.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 94a:7">Ḥull. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>ויהבה ניהליה במר דשחוטה</he> and he gave her (the ritually forbidden hen) to him (the gentile) pretending that it was ritually cut.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 30a:2">Bekh. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>מזבין ליה במר דכנתא</he> sold it for fat of the ileum (which is permitted; Ar. <cite ref="M02708"><he>מרכנתא</he></cite>, suggesting <cite ref="M00301"><he>מַדְכַנְתָּא</he></cite>, q. v.).
